title: Sar Barehna hai dayare gair Me binte ali
body:
Sar Barehna Hai Dayaar E Ghair Me Bint E Ali
Haye Zainab Haye Shaam (2)
Sar Barehna Hai Dayaar E Ghair Me Bint E Ali (2)
Abid E Dilgeer Ro'e Aur Sar E Shabbeer Bhi
Sar Barehna Hai Dayaar E Ghair Me Bint E Ali (2)
1) Dekh Ye Kaesi Hui Hai Teri Zainab Par Jafa
Waaris E Tat'heer Ho Kar Bhi Bahen Hai Be Rida
Haye Maiñ Lekar Balayeiñ Teri Kyuñ Na Mar Gayi
Sar Barehna Hai Dayaar E Ghair Me Bint E Ali (2)
2) Koi Mehmil Hai Na Haudaj Aur Nahiñ Sar Par Rida
Sar Pa Od'he Gham Ki Chaadar Chal Raha Hai Qafela
Aayiye Baba Madad Ko Hum Pa Aafat Hai Badi
Sar Barehna Hai Dayaar E Ghair Me Bint E Ali (2)
3) Ghir Gayi Hai Dushmano Ke Darmiyaañ Aal E Nabi
Koi Sadqa Phaiñk Ta Hai Sar Pa Angaare Koi
Khooñ Rulaata Hai Sinaañ Par Bhaai Ko Manzar Yehi
Sar Barehna Hai Dayaar E Ghair Me Bint E Ali (2)
4) Baba Baba Keh Ke Har Dam Roti Hai Dukhtar Teri
Sakhtiyaañ Ahl E Sitam Ki Sehti Hai Dukhtar Teri
Kar Rahi Hai Teri Beti Par Fughaañ Khud Be Kasi
Sar Barehna Hai Dayaar E Ghair Me Bint E Ali (2)
5) Jab Jari Ko Saniye Zehra Ka Sar Aaya Nazar
Aañkh Se Tapka Lahu Teh'ra Nahiñ Naize Pa Sar
Gir Gaya Karte Huwe Woh Khaak Par Nauha Yehi
Sar Barehna Hai Dayaar E Ghair Me Bint E Ali (2)
Haye zainab sa-2
6) Qafela Jab Shaam Ke Baazaar Me Aakar Ruka
Shaam Waloñ Se Ye Us Dam Ro Ke Fizza Ne Kaha
Apni Nazroñ Ko Jhukaao Hum Haiñ Namuse Nabi
Sar Barehna Hai Dayaar E Ghair Me Bint E Ali (2)
7) Kya anoosh e Ghamzada thi wo Qayamat ki ghadi
Jab kanizi me Jari ki laadli mangi gayi.
Thi sada har su'n Muqarrib Al madad Maula Ali
Kya "Muqarrib" Aur "Anoosh" Thi Wo Qayamath Ki Ghadi.
Jab Kanizi Me Jari Ki Laadli Mangi Gayi.
Sab ke Lab Par Yeh Sada Thi Al Madad Maula Ali (a.s).
